import sqlite3, json, datetime
U = lambda t: datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(t + 3*3600, datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%H:%M")
c = sqlite3.connect("file:/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall6.db?mode=ro", uri=True)
print("сделки в ob_wall6:")
for r in c.execute("select id,ts_open,symbol,entry,exit_type,net_pct,net_usdt,hold_sec,lo_pct,hi_pct,ref from trades order by id"):
    ref = json.loads(r[10]) if r[10] else {}
    print(" #%d %s %s вход %.6g  %s  net %+.2f%% (%+.3f$)  держал %.0fс мин %+.2f%% макс %+.2f%%  опора: %s" % (r[0], U(r[1]), r[2][:-4], r[3], r[4], r[5]*100, r[6], r[7], r[8], r[9], ("зона" if ref.get("mode") == "zone" and ref.get("zone_far") and abs(ref["zone_far"]-ref["wall"])>1e-12 else "стенка")))
print("стопы по заявкам (events):")
for r in c.execute("select ts,symbol,info from events where kind='buy_order' order by ts desc limit 6"): print(" ", U(r[0]), r[1][:-4], r[2])
print("всего buy_order/fill/cancel:", c.execute("select sum(kind='buy_order'), sum(kind='buy_fill'), sum(kind='buy_cancel') from events").fetchone())
